status: judgement policy; measurements and tiers pending complete fresh run
score_rule: sum of positive isolated bound savings per deduplicated program group, weighted by execution context, times generality divided by burden. Savings already include static occurrences; do not multiply by occurrences again.
deduplication: For each candidate family and count_group choose the largest positive isolated saving among variants/frontends; report all individual rows separately. This is a conservative alternative envelope, not a composed overlay.
